ASAM optical-glass shader source acknowledgements
================================================

home-scene-glass.js adapts the vertex transform and BVH refraction approach of
MeshRefractionMaterial in drei, originally authored by N8Programs:
https://github.com/pmndrs/drei/blob/master/src/materials/MeshRefractionMaterial.tsx
https://github.com/N8python/diamonds

The upstream shader snapshot used for the prototype has SHA-256:
6ec0cf695bd43525620e7c47855a8f1bbb075507c299e2bbbe7dd6cdc51d582a

ASAM adaptations include Fresnel transmission/reflection branches, accumulated
optical absorption, studio frost coating, fixed spatial grain and cap outlines.
There is no React or drei runtime dependency.

three-mesh-bvh
--------------
The BVH construction, uniform textures and GLSL intersection routines are
provided by three-mesh-bvh:
https://github.com/gkjohnson/three-mesh-bvh
